newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila index ends down on local, foreign selling.
newsitem.headline: Manila index ends down on local, foreign selling.

text.p: * PLDT, Ayala Land and Metro Pacific drag index down
Manila stocks finished lower on Thursday, falling for the fourth straight day on local and foreign selling, brokers said.
"The market was still in a selling mode. Most of the locals panicked and followed once again the lead of foreign players," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities Inc.
The main index closed down by 23.89 points, or 0.79 percent to 3,002.35, off its intra-day low of 2,973.53 points.
